ul.li: The <topicgroup> visually and functionally clusters “Getting Started,” “Administration,” and “Troubleshooting” topics without forcing them into a fixed book‑style chapter structure.
The same topic can appear in multiple maps (for example, a “Client Troubleshooting” topic in both the Client‑only guide and the Unified Help Portal), preserving modularity and reuse.
